title: 晨星腾讯AI支出：Q3见顶，2028收入才追上？
speaker: Lorraine Tan

segments.en: you're seeing from the Tencent earnings that these tech companies are really aggressively spending and willing to sacrifice margins as well as stalling profit growth, right?
segments.zh: 从腾讯财报可以看出，这些科技公司确实在大力投入，愿意牺牲利润率，也拖累了利润增长，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, what is your reaction to some of these earnings?
segments.zh: 你对这些财报有什么看法？

segments.en: Yeah, so actually what happened at Tencent is largely within our expectation, and I think the reason for that is that it's the companies are in a build-out phase, and a build-out phase
segments.zh: 其实腾讯的情况基本符合我们的预期，原因是这些公司正处于建设阶段，而在建设阶段

segments.en: you do expect the outflows to be there before the revenue catches up with the spending.
segments.zh: 你确实会预期在收入赶上支出之前，会有资金流出。

segments.en: So we actually do anticipate from most of the industry that we will see that sort of catch up, revenue start to catch up with the spending by 2028.
segments.zh: 所以我们确实预计，大多数行业到2028年收入会开始赶上支出。

segments.en: So what will happen then is that you will start to see that pressure start to reduce some of these companies.
segments.zh: 那么接下来，你会开始看到这些公司的压力有所减轻。

segments.en: And I think Tencent did mention that they think that the spending has peaked in the third quarter.
segments.zh: 我认为腾讯确实提到，他们认为支出在第三季度已经见顶。

segments.en: Okay. Is the market too bearish?
segments.zh: 好的。市场是否过于悲观？

segments.en: We think it's a little bit too bearish, and the reason we say that is that the monetization will come through.
segments.zh: 我们认为有点过于悲观，原因是变现将会实现。

segments.en: The reason, you know, the KPX has been surprising at the upside is because all the chip costs went up.
segments.zh: 你知道，KPX之所以意外上行，是因为所有芯片成本都上升了。

segments.en: These companies are committed to the spending right now, which is a good thing. Yes, but when we're starting to see those chip prices come off, so the input costs start to ease, and I think that's part of the reason why we're, you know, I guess
segments.zh: 这些公司目前正投入支出，这是好事。但当我们开始看到芯片价格回落，输入成本开始缓解，我认为这也是我们更乐观的部分原因。

segments.en: more optimistic, and we do see value in these companies.
segments.zh: 更乐观，而且我们确实看到这些公司的价值。
